summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 24, 2026. The filing includes the Notice of AGM and proxy materials. The board recommends voting in favor of proposed resolutions. Record holders of ordinary shares as of May 22, 2026 are entitled to vote; ADS holders must act through the depositary. No price, premium, or financial terms are involved. This is a routine AGM notice, not a special situation.
